calibration_note: reproduces DRU section 5: outer 0.525 mm, inner 2.734 mm for BAT_MAIN 1.5 A @ 10 K

via.note: 0.80/0.40 POWER-class through via (qrouter QBoard.via default); plating 25 um is a conservative JLC assumption -- UNVERIFIED against a fab traveller, flagged.

ruling.rationale: Per-via conservative capacity (internal FR4, 10 K rise) = 1.055 A. Ideal-sharing need for 1.75 A validation = 2 vias; but current sharing from a single incoming trace is uneven, so the floor is raised to 3 (capacity 3.17 A @10K = 1.81x margin; tolerates one open via -> 2 remain, 2.11 A > 1.75 A). Design target is 4 for headroom and 2:1-imbalance safety (hottest via then rises only ~6.5 K). No single-via bottleneck at either transition.
unverified: plating thickness 25 um (JLC typical; not from a fab traveller)
no thermal coupling credit taken for barrel-to-plane conduction (would only improve capacity) -- conservative
IPC-2221B applied to a via barrel is the conservative industry proxy; a via is better cooled than a surface trace of equal area
